messages:
Maya: Quick sync — finalizing the March product newsletter + webinar invite. Need a decision on segmentation, send windows, and inbound lead routing by EOD.

Ethan: For audience counts, top-level: ~8.2k active trial users, ~1.1k recent logins in last 7d. If we gate webinar to 'active trials only' we get ~3.4k.

Priya: Proposal: 3-segment nurture drip for the launch email:
- Segment A: Highly engaged (used >3 features, last 7d) — 1 email (invite + quick win).
- Segment B: Trials, no recent activity (14–30d) — 3-email drip with tips + webinar CTA.
- Segment C: Lapsed trials (>30d) — reactivation subject, single invite + replay teaser.

Ben: Send windows: US East 9–11am local, EU target UTC 13:00–15:00. Holdback control: 5% per segment for conversion baseline.

Maya: Subject line A/B ideas? We should test headline vs tactical benefit.\nPriya: A: "Inside: How teams cut inference cost 40%"
Priya: B: "Webinar: Practical tricks to lower token spend"

Ethan: Also recommend different preheaders: A -> quick stat, B -> list of 3 practical tips.

Maya: Routing: webinar signups need to go to SFDC with campaign=Mar-Webinar-2026 and utm_source=newsletter. Who owns the mapping?

Ben: I'll wire the routing. Plan: form -> our webhook -> marvin-sfdc-bot -> SFDC Campaign Member. Include source, list segment, ab_variant, and holdback flag.

Maya: Can we get a sample webhook payload to hand to Sales ops?

Ben: payload example (simple JSON) inline: 

`{
  "email": "{{email}}",
  "first_name": "{{first_name}}",
  "campaign": "Mar-Webinar-2026",
  "utm_source": "newsletter",
  "segment": "{{segment}}",
  "ab_variant": "A|B",
  "holdback": "true|false"
}`

Priya: Also map `email_tags` = `newsletter_march_webinar` so we can filter in Pardot later.

marvin-sfdc-bot: Received webhook spec. Will create Campaign Member with fields: Email, FirstName, CampaignId, LeadSource=newsletter, Segment__c, AB_Variant__c, Holdback__c. Notify when mapping deployed.

campaign-bot: Scheduled send created: "Mar Newsletter + Webinar Invite" — Draft -> ready for review. Send window: 2026-03-24 US/EU per segment.

Maya: Action items: Ben to push webhook (today), Priya to finalize subject/preheaders (this afternoon), Ethan to confirm exact audience query (by 3pm). I'll merge final content and schedule review.

Ethan: FYI — I'll add a 5% sample list export so ops can sanity-check SFDC joins.

Priya: I'll prepare the 3-email cadence copy drafts and notify.

Maya: Perfect. If no objections I'll lock segmentation + routing at 5pm PST. :white_check_mark:
